item.text:
**Bottom Line**

Scholz is not clearly closer overall to his 2024 program by year-end than he was at the start. He did convert parts of the agenda into concrete policy, especially on security, digital regulation, social spending, and mission review, and inflation eased. But the coalition collapsed, parliamentary confidence vanished, and independent oversight problems remained. Net effect: some short-term advances, but weaker durability and less political capacity by December.

**Claim-Level Items**

- **Agreement on 2025 budget and growth initiative** | Federal Government | 5 Jul 2024 | URL: https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/budget-2025-2298116 | Scholz and coalition partners turned a difficult bargaining round into a concrete 49-measure package on modernization, infrastructure, social housing, renewables, tax relief, and Ukraine support. This is the clearest midyear sign that the government still could translate goals into actionable policy. | IDs: `8B.10`, `8B.8`, `8B.9`

- **First overarching evaluation of Bundeswehr missions abroad** | Federal Foreign Office / Federal Ministry of Defence | 26 Jun 2024 | URL: https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/newsroom/news/2664958-2664958 | The government reviewed seven missions with uniform criteria and explicitly identified improvements, including more realistic goals and better civilian-military coordination. This is evidence of institutional learning and some progress toward a more disciplined program. | IDs: `8B.10`, `8B.8`

- **Germany will approve EU’s planned AI Act - sources** | Reuters | 30 Jan 2024 | URL: https://www.investing.com/news/economy/germany-will-approve-eus-planned-ai-act--sources-3286730 | Reuters reported that internal coalition resistance was resolved and Germany moved toward a “trustworthy AI” compromise. This shows Scholz’s bloc could still convert resistance into policy output early in the year. | IDs: `8B.10`, `8B.8`, `8B.9`

- **Germany agrees phaseout of Huawei/ZTE components in 5G core network** | Reuters | 11 Jul 2024 | URL: https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/DEUTSCHE-TELEKOM-AG-444661/news/Germany-agrees-phaseout-of-Huawei-ZTE-components-in-5G-core-network-47361811/ | Germany set a concrete timetable to remove risky components from core networks. That is a real implementation win on critical infrastructure and suggests some increase in strategic control versus the start of the year. | IDs: `8B.10`, `8B.8`, `8B.9`

- **Bundesbank forecast: German economy slowly regaining its footing** | Deutsche Bundesbank | 7 Jun 2024 | URL: https://www.bundesbank.de/en/press/press-releases/bundesbank-forecast-for-germany-german-economy-slowly-regaining-its-footing-933658 | The Bundesbank still saw modest growth, falling inflation, and a stable labor market by midyear. This supports a partial end-state improvement in conditions compared with the prior shock period, though not a decisive turnaround. | IDs: `8B.10`

- **Inflation averaged 2.2% in 2024** | German Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) | 16 Jan 2025 | URL: https://www.destatis.de/EN/Press/2025/01/PE25_020_611.html | Inflation ended 2024 far below the prior shock years, which is a real partial success for economic stabilization. It helps the “closer by year-end” argument, but only modestly. | IDs: `8B.10`

- **Coalition collapses after Lindner dismissal** | Reuters via Investing.com | 6 Nov 2024 | URL: https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936 | Scholz’s dismissal of Lindner did not stabilize the system; it triggered coalition collapse, political chaos, and minority-rule uncertainty. This is strong counterevidence that the governing program was farther from durable realization at the end than at the start. | IDs: `8B.10`, `8B.8`, `8B.9`

- **Bundestag withdraws confidence from Scholz** | Deutscher Bundestag | 16 Dec 2024 | URL: https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198 | Parliament’s large no-confidence vote shows the chancellorship ended with much weaker authority than it began. That is direct counterevidence to any claim of end-of-period consolidation. | IDs: `8B.10`, `8B.9`

- **BND surveillance powers found partly unconstitutional** | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 8 Nov 2024 | URL: https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html | The court found key surveillance powers unconstitutional and oversight inadequate. This shows unresolved structural weakness in the control apparatus, which cuts against a clean claim of durable program advancement. | IDs: `8B.10`, `8B.9`

- **Legal memo on Warburg affair scrutiny** | Tagesspiegel | 4 Jun 2024 | URL: https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/geheimes-kanzleramts-gutachten-in-cum-ex-affare-scholz-darf-weiter-in-deckung-bleiben-11756357.html | Reporting suggested the Chancellery used a legal memo to blunt Bundestag scrutiny over the Warburg/Cum-Ex affair. If accurate, this points to defensive containment rather than stronger transparent control, which weakens the “closer to the program” claim. | IDs: `8B.10`, `8B.9`

- **German GDP fell 0.2% in 2024** | German Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) | 15 Jan 2025 | URL: https://www.destatis.de/EN/Press/2025/01/PE25_019_811.html | The economy still contracted in 2024, so the government did not achieve a durable macroeconomic breakthrough by year-end. This is outcome-based counterevidence against a strong progress claim. | IDs: `8B.10`

**Synthesis**

- The strongest “closer by year-end” evidence is programmatic, not institutional: budget package, AI/5G regulation, mission review, and lower inflation.
- The strongest “not closer” evidence is political and structural: coalition collapse, no-confidence vote, GDP contraction, and unresolved oversight failures.
- Best read: Scholz made some short-term policy gains in 2024, but by the end of the period he was not clearly closer overall to his revealed program in a durable sense.
